# Forge MDK notices

These unchanged license and credits files came with the Minecraft Forge 1.12.2 Mod Development Kit (MDK). They concern Forge and its audio libraries, including IBXM and Paulscode CodecIBXM.

They do not identify the author or set the license of the original Settlements code. Settlements is by MechGaming; its ownership notice is in the [project LICENSE](../../../LICENSE).

The current Settlements production jar does not bundle these notices or the Forge, IBXM, or Paulscode library classes. The files are retained here with their original contents.
